name: Single Point Alpha Forward
definition: Computes the alpha value for a single 3D Gaussian projected onto a 2D pixel. It transforms the Gaussian to camera space, computes the 2D covariance, projects it to screen space, and evaluates the 2D Gaussian probability density at the pixel center.
summary: Single Point Alpha Forward computes the alpha value for a single 3D Gaussian projected onto a 2D pixel by evaluating its 2D Gaussian probability density function at the pixel center.
